doc.title: Epic 3: Intelligent RAG Query Engine
doc.snippet: Blend semantic and keyword retrieval to handle edge cases where BM25 outperforms pure vectors. BM25/Postgres full-text search alongside vector search, with score normalization and result merging.

doc.title: Data Architecture - PostgreSQL Schema
doc.snippet: PostgreSQL supports tsvector + tsquery for keyword matching with ts_rank_cd() for BM25-like scoring. Can extend existing tables or create knowledge_chunks table with tsvector column for efficient indexing.

doc.title: Pattern 2: Markdown-First Knowledge Pipeline
doc.snippet: All documents saved as .md with YAML frontmatter. Hybrid chunking respects markdown structure (headers = semantic boundaries). Text stored in ~/.jarvis/knowledge/ for both vector and full-text indexing.

doc.title: FR1: RAG Query System
doc.snippet: Target < 2s (P95) for RAG queries. Embedding caching via Redis (5 min TTL). Qdrant tuning with HNSW index (m=16, ef_construct=200). Database connection pooling (5-10 connections).

doc.snippet: src/jarvis/memory/search.py provides search_memory(query, k, domains) returning SearchResult[] with scores. SearchResult dataclass includes text, score, source_file, section, domain, metadata with chunk_id.

constraints.constraint: Query latency target: < 2s (P95) for RAG queries. Hybrid search must run semantic and keyword searches in parallel or sequentially without exceeding target.
Database connection pooling: 5-10 connections configured. Keyword search queries must use existing connection pool from postgres.py.
Score normalization required before merging: Use min-max normalization to bring vector scores [0-1] and BM25 scores to comparable range.
Weighted merging: hybrid_score = (weight * semantic_score) + ((1 - weight) * keyword_score). Default weight should be configurable.
SearchResult dataclass is standard - maintain same structure for keyword and hybrid results to ensure compatibility with query.py formatter.
Mock patching pattern: Patch where functions are used (e.g., jarvis.cli.query.search_memory) not where defined (jarvis.memory.search.search_memory).
Code style: Black formatting (line-length=100), Ruff linting (E, W, F, I, B, C4, UP checks), type hints required (mypy strict mode).
Test coverage target: pytest with --cov=jarvis, show missing lines. Story 3.1 achieved 94% coverage - maintain similar standard.

interface.name: SearchResult
interface.signature: @dataclass class SearchResult: text: str score: float source_file: Optional[str] section: Optional[str] domain: Optional[str] metadata: dict
interface.usage: Standard result structure for all retrieval modes. Reuse this for keyword_search() and hybrid_search() return values.

interface.name: search_memory
interface.signature: def search_memory( query: str, *, k: int = 10, domains: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None, client: Optional["qdrant_db.QdrantClient"] = None, ) -> List[SearchResult]:
interface.usage: Existing semantic search function. New keyword_search() and hybrid_search() should follow same signature pattern (query, k, domains, optional client/session for testing).

interface.name: keyword_search
interface.signature: def keyword_search( query: str, *, k: int = 10, domains: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None, session: Optional[Session] = None, ) -> List[SearchResult]:
interface.usage: New function for PostgreSQL full-text search using tsvector, tsquery, ts_rank_cd(). Returns SearchResult[] compatible with existing code.

interface.name: hybrid_search
interface.signature: def hybrid_search( query: str, *, k: int = 10, weight: float = 0.7, domains: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None, client: Optional["qdrant_db.QdrantClient"] = None, session: Optional[Session] = None, ) -> List[SearchResult]:
interface.usage: New function that calls both search_memory() and keyword_search(), normalizes scores, merges with weighted formula, returns top-k unified SearchResult[].

interface.name: get_session
interface.usage: Use for PostgreSQL queries in keyword_search(). Provides session with automatic commit/rollback/close. Execute raw SQL with session.execute(text("SELECT ...")).
